content.summary: Completed: Fix tool status stuck on Running in claude-agent-sdk

data.root_cause: processSDKMessage only emitted tool-result when tool_use_summary had summary field, and never emitted tool-error. Tools stayed in running state until stream end, then marked aborted.
data.fix_applied: Updated processSDKMessage to: (1) emit tool-result for any tool_use_summary even without summary using 'Tool completed.' default, (2) emit tool-error when is_error/error fields present, (3) always delete from state.toolCalls after emitting to prevent aborted marking
